scope: independent root audit of binary discriminant classes, the ternary reciprocal coefficient cone, normalized Newton stability, definite-form separation, live conic scope, capacity, and zero booking

mathematical_audit.binary: Negative discriminant gives the exact completed-square lower bound. Square discriminant gives rational linear factors. A nonsquare positive discriminant forbids a rational projective zero, while primitive reduction leaves the sharp integer norm bound |Q(T)| at least gcd(T1,T2)^2; Pell solutions show that positivity alone cannot improve it.
mathematical_audit.ternary_coefficient_cone: Expanding e1*e3 and e2^2 gives weight-four coefficients d, c+2d, and 4c+6d. Hence d>=0 and 2c+3d>=0 are necessary and sufficient there; together with the unmixed weights this gives exactly the six stated sign inequalities.
mathematical_audit.newton_stability: Direct symmetric-polynomial comparison verifies the pair-difference-square identity. Two distinct singleton loads differ, their reciprocal gap exceeds A^(-4), and one outside reciprocal contributes more than A^(-4) to the positive kernel, giving the A^(-12) gap and A^(-12)N^(-2) normalized separation.
mathematical_audit.definite_ternary: The nonzero integral determinant and a 6B operator-norm bound force the smallest eigenvalue above (6B)^(-2), hence |Q(T)|>=M^2/(72B^2).
mathematical_audit.live_conic_scope: At the ambient loads (1,1,2,2), (T1,T2,T3)=(12,13,6), the rank-three form 169*T1*T3-72*T2^2 vanishes while the normalized Newton gap is 28. This is an obstruction to cone-only arguments, not an actual-family carrier or density datum.
mathematical_audit.capacity: No actual sub-beta divisibility carrier or weighted singleton upper bound is produced; beta capacity and the Route-1 ledger remain unchanged.
